//notes: Each value is the MAX acceptable lava/node wall-time ratio (lava is allowed to be up to Nx Node's time). A benchmark with no entry here is report-only (never fails the gate). Calibrated 2026-07-11 against the perf/buffer tip (observed ratio x ~1.5-2 headroom for CI noise); re-run `make bench` and tighten further as the ratios improve.

caps.//encoding: Added 2026-07-27 with bench/micro/encoding.js. The absolute ratios are high because everything except decode-utf8-fastpath is a pure-JS codec against Node's native ICU/C++ one; the caps catch a REGRESSION, they do not claim parity. Caps are ~1.4x the typical ratio on a quiet box. decode-win1252 has NO cap on purpose (report-only): its measured run-to-run spread reaches 2.26x under load, larger than the ~1.43x effect a cap would exist to catch, so no value separates signal from noise - a light that fires on one clean run in four and misses the regression 40% of the time trains reviewers to re-run. decode-utf8-stream keeps 17.0: widening it to 19.0 was measured to cost detection (100% -> 66-91%) without removing the false positives it was meant to fix (22% still trip 19.0 under heavy load), i.e. a middle position worse than either end. On a breach, re-run and compare MEDIANS of >=3 launches before believing it: median-of-3 cuts the loaded-box false-positive rate from ~24% to ~16% with detection unchanged at 100%. The gate itself reads a single launch (bench/run.mjs) - see the ROADMAP item.
